description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Senior Data Architect (French-speaking) to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct the initial assessment of the current data architecture and define a scalable target-state architecture.
  • Design an architecture that supports the integration of new subsidiaries as the business expands.
  • Develop architectural solutions to eliminate the existing single point of failure.
  • Establish and improve data quality standards and data modeling practices.
  • Evaluate cloud, on-premises, and hybrid approaches and recommend an appropriate architecture.
  • Design data warehousing and data platform solutions within Microsoft SQL Server-based environments.
  • Support data governance initiatives from an architectural perspective.
  • Define and support REST API-based integrations.
  • Support implementation and testing during the delivery phase.
  • Senior-level experience in Data Architecture.
  • Proven ability to assess existing environments and define scalable target-state architectures.
  • Strong background in Data Warehousing and Data Platform Design.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs.
  • Experience assessing and designing cloud, on-premises, and hybrid architectures.
  • Deep knowledge of Data Quality management and Data Modeling.
  • Solid understanding of Data Governance foundations.
  • Experience supporting architecture implementation and testing.
  • French level: C1 (Advanced) or higher.
  • English level: B1 (Intermediate) or higher.
